text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari received the U.S. ambassador Mary Ann Casey. The Middle East peace process was discussed.
- Tunisian haj pilgrims to Saudi Arabia this year up to 8,000 (from 7,000 last year). Cost for each pilgrim is 2,400 dinars.
- The European Investment Bank is to lend Tunisia 49 million dinars (40 million ECUs).
- First group of Tunisian pilgrims arrives in Jeddah on Friday.
- Tunisia's state run electricity and gas company STEG celebrates its 35th anniversary.
